description: Use this when get_youtube_transcript (mode 'auto' or 'generate') answered with a job_id because the AI transcript was still being made. Returns the transcript when the job is done, says it is still running otherwise (wait about 5 seconds and call again), or the error if it failed (credits are refunded then). Free: the credits were taken when the job started. Only jobs started by this account can be read; jobs are kept 7 days.

send_metadata.description: Include title/author metadata. Defaults to true.

timestamps.description: One line per segment, each starting with its [m:ss] start time. Defaults to false.

name: get_transcript_job
